followCamera.rootCauseFixed: S.x/S.y are WORLD PIXELS but were projected with px-per-TILE (16x too far), so the follow offset always clamped to an extreme and the hero marker was drawn off-screen. The hero sprite was also omitted at overview scale. Now the player is converted with /TILE and a hero marker is ALWAYS drawn.
followCamera.fitFollow: proportional camera slide inside the letterbox; whole 4000x2800 frame stays visible
followCamera.centerFollow: player exactly centred at viewport centre; map scrolls under it (may clip)
followCamera.note: The native 1x camera NEVER stops following the player; zoom only changes the overview viewer layer.

wholeMapZoom.note: Zoom is a VIEWER control only, NOT a camera Gameplay law change.

isolatedCellDespeckle.report: có khá nhiều và bất hợp lí các ô A được vây quanh 4 phía bởi ô B
isolatedCellDespeckle.rootCause: biomeCodeAt() jitters EVERY tile independently by +/-2.6 AU against the 8 AU analysis raster; near a biome boundary a lone tile picks the other cell while all 4 orthogonal neighbours pick one cell. The verbatim renderChunk() PRIO edge dither then amplifies each speck.
isolatedCellDespeckle.fix: 3 deterministic passes over a bounded 34x34 tile window (32x32 chunk + 1-tile border): an eligible BIOME centre whose 4 orthogonal neighbours are the SAME biome tile and differ from the centre adopts that neighbour tile. Later passes read the UPDATED grid, so cascades are resolved.
isolatedCellDespeckle.eligible: authored land tile whose code is one of MEADOW/GRASS/FOREST/MARSH/SAND/HILL/SNOW/ASH/TOXIC
isolatedCellDespeckle.preservedByTileCode: ROAD, BRIDGE, RIVER, DEEP, SHALLOW, CLIFF, ICE, LAVA, FLOOR, PWALL, BURNT are never smoothable, so the Creator-liked Beacon road and every authored water/shore/bridge/cliff tile are unchanged.
isolatedCellDespeckle.bounded: <=256 resident 34x34 windows LRU; whole 11.2M-cell frame never allocated; coarse whole-map overview keeps using the RAW sampler (specks are sub-pixel at 8-tile stride)
